description: This Java source file defines an Android activity called Hover that demonstrates handling hover events within an Android application. It sets up UI components including a container view with a hover listener, a message text view, a checkbox to toggle hover interception, and a custom interceptor view. The activity updates a text view with hover position details when the user hovers over UI elements.

classes.name: Hover
classes.description: An Android activity demonstrating hover event handling, updating UI elements based on hover interactions and controlling hover intercept behavior via a checkbox.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and configures hover and checkbox listeners.
